Global context.FindByRef

Global context

FindByRef

Available since version 8.3.5.

Syntax:

FindByRef(<ReferenceList>, <SearchArea>, <IncludeObjects>, <ExcludeObjects>)

Parameters:

<ReferenceList> (required)

Type: Array.
Array with list of references to the objects to be found.

<SearchArea> (optional)

Type: Array.
It defines the object search area. The area is set by a combination of separators that include metadata objectsamong the data of which the search should be performed.
The type of the array item is Array.
The type of the nested array is as follows:
  • Metadata object is a common attribute separating data.
  • String is a name of the common attribute separating data.
The default value is Undefined.
Allowed values:
  • Undefined,
  • Array with a combination of separators defining the search area,
  • Empty array - the search area is defined by parameters of the <IncludeObjects> and <ExcludeObjects> method.
Note: If the separator combination contains repeats, an exception is called as the configuration may not have metadata objects that are twice included in the same separator.

<IncludeObjects> (optional)

Type: Array.
It allows specifying directly metadata objects that should be available in the area of search for references to objects.
The array item may be represented by:
  • Metadata object.
  • String is a full name of the metadata object.
Allowed values:
  • Undefined,
  • Empty array,
  • Array of metadata objects.

<ExcludeObjects> (optional)

Type: Array.
The array items can be represented by:
  • Metadata object,
  • String is a full name of the metadata object.
The property makes it possible to specify directly metadata objects that should be excluded from the area of search for references to objects.
Allowed values:
  • Undefined
  • Empty array (no objects to be added to the search area).
  • Array of metadata objects.

Returned value:

Type: ValueTable.
It returns references to the objects found in ValueTable.
First column - source reference.
Second column - reference to object, if found reference corresponds with object table or value, representing a record of non-object table.
Third column - metadata object, corresponding to data, where the reference is found.

Description:

It searches for references to objects given in the <ReferenceList> parameter.
The search only includes data available within the current session with regard to the split (conditional split is also taken into account).
The search includes all data which can contain links to the transferred objects. An exception is called if the user has no access rights for the object.

Availability:

Server, thick client, external connection, mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.
Calling the method executes a server call.

Note:

If the <SearchArea> parameter is not defined or if the Version8_3_4 configuration compatibility mode or the configuration compatibility mode with a lower version is used, the search is performed in all data that are available within the current session taking into account the separation (conditional separation is also taken into account).
Such parameters as <SearchArea>, <IncludeObjects>, <ExcludeObjects>} are ignored on the mobile platform.

Example:

References = FindMarkedForDeletion();
ReferencesTable = FindByRef(References);
For Each Ref In ReferencesTable Do
    Message ("" + TrimAll(Ref[0]) + "  " + TrimAll(Ref[1]));
EndDo;

Available since:

Available since version 8.3.5.
